Recorded claim:
`lib/milestone.mjs:getRepositoryMilestone(repositoryPath)` reads `<repositoryPath>/mail/config/version.txt`, extracts the numeric major version, and maps `153.0a1` to `153 Branch`. `markGraphBugForCheckin` sends `target_milestone` and `checkin-needed-tb` in one Bugzilla update; the helper is shared by graph landing and legacy `commands/land.mjs`. [Task 1]
